features.statement: Dark theme with near-black page background and warm off-white body text.
A single saturated burnt-orange accent is used for announcement bar, filled buttons, eyebrow labels and list markers.
Text on accent-colored fills is dark near-black rather than white.
Secondary text, nav links and labels use a muted warm gray.
Serif display typeface for headings paired with system sans-serif for body and UI text.
Large headings (H1 and H2) are set in regular weight rather than bold.
Body text is about 17px with a generous line height around 1.65.
Small, widely letter-spaced uppercase accent-colored eyebrow label sits above the main headline.
Brand name rendered as a text wordmark in serif rather than a logo image.
Full-width accent-colored announcement bar at page top with a single underlined centered link.
Sticky semi-transparent header with backdrop blur, wordmark left and horizontal nav right.
Full-bleed dark painterly hero image behind left-aligned text, darkened toward edges for legibility.
Buttons are fully rounded pills, with a filled accent primary and an outlined off-white secondary paired.
A centered band of titles separated by decorative star glyphs sits on a slightly lighter dark tone.
Two-column split section with image on one side and heading, paragraph and CTA on the other.
Gallery thumbnails are cropped to a uniform frame with slightly rounded corners.
Section header places the heading left and a muted one-line subtitle right-aligned on the same row.
Content aligns to a consistent centered container of about 1120px.
Generous vertical padding between sections creates wide empty dark gaps.
Single-column contact form occupies only half the container, leaving the other side empty.
Form fields are dark recessed boxes darker than their section, with subtle borders and small radii.
Sections are separated by thin hairline rules and alternating background tones, not ornamental dividers.
Minimal footer with copyright and privacy link left and account link right, underlined.
Hidden modal dialog with its own form is included for login.
Uses semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, section, footer) and all images have alt text.
Styling is a single inline style block with few non-utility classes and CSS grid-based layout.
No SVG icons; decorative marks like carets and stars are text glyphs.
Sparse, curatorial copy with no emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes, repeating a signature epithet.
Interactions use CSS transitions rather than animations or transforms.
